name: @gaiadesk/node
description: GaiaDesk's support API from your Node.js server: typed support sessions, attachments, waiting alerts, listeners and requests, plus webhook signature verification. Zero dependencies.

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['dist', 'dist-test']) require('node:fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run build:test && npm run typecheck:examples && node --test dist-test/
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
